scripts.db:tables: wrangler d1 execute agrobot-db --remote --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;"
scripts.db:farmers: wrangler d1 execute agrobot-db --remote --command "SELECT id, phone, name, location, crops, onboarding_step, onboarding_completed, created_at, last_active FROM farmers ORDER BY last_active DESC LIMIT 50;"
scripts.db:farmers:count: wrangler d1 execute agrobot-db --remote --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS farmers_count FROM farmers;"
scripts.db:rows: wrangler d1 execute agrobot-db --remote --command "SELECT 'farmers' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS rows_count FROM farmers UNION ALL SELECT 'price_cache' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS rows_count FROM price_cache UNION ALL SELECT 'diagnoses' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS rows_count FROM diagnoses;"
